senses.ex: The external walls of the house need painting.
senses.exPt: As paredes externas da casa precisam de pintura.

senses.def: no longer existing because all of them have died
senses.ex: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
senses.exPt: Os dinossauros foram extintos há milhões de anos.

senses.def: the situation when a type of animal or plant no longer exists
senses.ex: Many animals are in danger of extinction.
senses.exPt: Muitos animais correm risco de extinção.

senses.def: getting money from someone by threats or force
senses.ex: The gang leader was arrested for extortion.
senses.exPt: O líder da gangue foi preso por extorsão.

senses.def: more than the usual amount or number
senses.ex: Can I have an extra blanket, please?
senses.exPt: Pode me dar um cobertor extra, por favor?

senses.def: in addition to the usual price or amount
senses.ex: You have to pay extra for breakfast.
senses.exPt: Você tem que pagar a mais pelo café da manhã.

senses.def: to remove or take something out, often with effort
senses.ex: The oil is extracted from olives.
senses.exPt: O óleo é extraído das azeitonas.

senses.def: a short part taken from a book, piece of music or film
senses.ex: The teacher read us an extract from the novel.
senses.exPt: A professora leu para nós um trecho do romance.

senses.def: very much; to an unusual degree
senses.ex: She is extraordinarily talented for her age.
senses.exPt: Ela é extremamente talentosa para a idade dela.

senses.def: very unusual, special or surprising
senses.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
senses.exPt: Ela tem um talento extraordinário para a música.

senses.def: spending much more money than is necessary or sensible
senses.ex: Buying a new car every year is pure extravagance.
senses.exPt: Comprar um carro novo todo ano é puro esbanjamento.

senses.def: something expensive that you buy or do although you do not need it
senses.ex: A weekend in Paris was our one extravagance this year.
senses.exPt: Um fim de semana em Paris foi o nosso único luxo este ano.

senses.def: very great, or much more than usual
senses.ex: The region has extreme cold in the winter.
senses.exPt: A região tem um frio extremo no inverno.

senses.def: used about sports that are exciting and dangerous
senses.ex: He loves extreme sports like skydiving and surfing.
senses.exPt: Ele adora esportes radicais, como paraquedismo e surfe.

senses.def: dangerous and exciting sports, such as skydiving
senses.ex: My brother loves extreme sports like skydiving.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão adora esportes radicais, como paraquedismo.

senses.def: very; much more than usual
senses.ex: The test was extremely difficult, and many students failed.
senses.exPt: A prova foi extremamente difícil, e muitos alunos foram reprovados.

senses.def: the quality of being full of energy, excitement and happiness
senses.ex: The children's exuberance filled the whole house.
senses.exPt: A animação das crianças tomava conta da casa toda.

senses.def: full of energy, excitement and happiness
senses.ex: The exuberant fans sang and danced outside the stadium.
senses.exPt: Os torcedores empolgados cantavam e dançavam do lado de fora do estádio.

senses.def: growing strongly and in large amounts
senses.ex: The garden was full of exuberant tropical plants.
senses.exPt: O jardim estava cheio de plantas tropicais exuberantes.

senses.def: in a very happy, energetic and excited way
senses.ex: She greeted us exuberantly, hugging everyone at the door.
senses.exPt: Ela nos recebeu com entusiasmo, abraçando todo mundo na porta.

senses.def: very happy and excited because of a success
senses.ex: The exultant fans ran onto the field after the final whistle.
senses.exPt: Os torcedores eufóricos invadiram o campo depois do apito final.

senses.def: one of the two parts of the face you see with
senses.ex: My sister has big green eyes.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã tem olhos verdes grandes.

senses.def: the line of hair above each eye
senses.ex: He raised an eyebrow when he heard the price.
senses.exPt: Ele levantou a sobrancelha quando ouviu o preço.

senses.def: one of the short hairs that grow on the edge of the eyelid
senses.ex: She has really long eyelashes.
senses.exPt: Ela tem cílios bem compridos.

senses.def: the piece of skin that covers your eye when it is closed
senses.ex: My left eyelid keeps twitching when I'm tired.
senses.exPt: Minha pálpebra esquerda fica tremendo quando estou cansado.

senses.def: the ability to see
senses.ex: My grandfather's eyesight is getting worse every year.
senses.exPt: A visão do meu avô está piorando a cada ano.
